findings: Approved bounded recovery. Independently verified the original failed G1 attempt remains unranked, one launch is consumed, the diagnostic timing is 1335.412622417 seconds, exact runtime execution is valid after adding the two declaration-bound batch metadata fields to an in-memory contract copy, and the corrected runner expands those fields into new batch-metrics receipts. Recovery creates a pre-repair state snapshot and receipt before launching a new immutable baseline-g1-retry stage. Also rechecked signal cleanup, ZGC generation evidence, per-stage profile custody, censor labeling, parser coverage and selection behavior. The original failed stage is not rewritten.
limits: Review included static checks, lightweight tests and read-only inspection of recovery receipts; it did not independently re-audit all timed raw worker artifacts or execute workload stages. Each successful stage still requires strict validation, exact economics and curves comparison, byte conservation and the frozen independent 7200-trade/16-book replay.
scope: Independent static review of the plan, collector profiles/probes, controller/runner/parser, campaign sequencing and censoring, evidence packaging, bounded runner-failure recovery, plus 23 unit tests and read-only verification against the immutable first-stage receipts.
